task.title: Make task updates independent and documentation CI lightweight
task.problem: A shared registry and generated index create conflicts; post-merge status PRs repeat expensive validation.
task.proposal: Store one JSON file per task, generate reports on demand, include completion evidence in implementation PRs, and select lightweight CI for documentation-only diffs.
acceptance: Existing tasks and evidence survive migration and dependencies validate across files.
Independent task edits need no shared file or post-merge completion PR.
Documentation-only changes skip Python/BuildStream matrices; mixed changes and manual runs select full CI.
An always-running result check fails if selected validation fails.
evidence: 67 non-integration tests passed locally, including task-file validation and CI routing; Ruff lint/format and exact preservation of all 22 existing tasks passed.
